desc:
🏎️ **Welcome to Formula Racing 2026 Roblox!** 🏁

Jump into the world of high-speed open-wheel racing and prove you have what it takes to become champion. Race across a huge variety of tracks, drive powerful cars, earn cash, battle other players, or create your own racing circuits!

🔥 **Features:**

🏎️ **77+ cars** to drive
🌍 **36+ tracks** to master
🏗️ **Build your own fully functional tracks in-game**
🧱 **Hundreds of props** to build & decorate with
💾 **Save & publish your custom tracks**
🏆 **Host races and events on your own creations**
💸 Earn cash and unlock more con
